entitlement_event_grant_period.name: entitlement_event_grant_period
entitlement_event_grant_period.value: "entitlement_event"."kind" not in ('grant', 'replace') or ("entitlement_event"."plan_id" is not null and "entitlement_event"."starts_at" is not null and "entitlement_event"."ends_at" > "entitlement_event"."starts_at")

payment_submission_approval_evidence.name: payment_submission_approval_evidence
payment_submission_approval_evidence.value: "payment_submission"."status" not in ('approved', 'refunded') or ("payment_submission"."settlement_ref" is not null and "payment_submission"."reviewed_at" is not null)

profile_caste_needs_consent.name: profile_caste_needs_consent
profile_caste_needs_consent.value: "profile"."caste" is null or "profile"."caste_consented_at" is not null

profile_published_complete.name: profile_published_complete
profile_published_complete.value: "profile"."status" <> 'published' or ("profile"."display_name" is not null and "profile"."gender" is not null and "profile"."birth_date" is not null and "profile"."country_code" is not null and "profile"."city" is not null and "profile"."occupation" is not null and "profile"."education" is not null and "profile"."height_cm" is not null and "profile"."marital_status" is not null and "profile"."bio" is not null and "profile"."adult_declared_at" is not null)
